label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
**Sunbelt Charter Coaches: don't book them for anything big right now**

Posting this because I know a lot of us use Sunbelt for airport and offsite runs, and people should have the facts before CES season.

On Thursday, Nov 5, I had a client dinner for 220 at a ranch venue in Henderson, with hotel pickup at 6:15. I booked four coaches. Sunbelt confirmed in writing twice, most recently on Tuesday, Nov 3. I paid $8,400 in full, with a 50% deposit in September and the balance seven days out.

Two buses showed up. The first was 55 minutes late, and the driver told me he'd only been given the job at 5pm. The second broke down on the 215 with no AC, and my guests sat on the shoulder for about 40 minutes. The other two coaches never came at all. Nobody from Sunbelt called before, during, or after.

I ended up putting 60 people in Ubers and Lyfts on my company card, which came to about $1,900. Dinner started at 8:40 instead of 7:00, and the caterer charged us overtime. My client is now reviewing whether to keep us for their March event.

The dispatcher on all my paperwork was Corey. The office line has gone straight to voicemail since Friday, and I haven't gotten a call back. I'm asking for a refund on the two coaches that never arrived, plus the rideshare costs. So far I've gotten nothing.

To be fair, I used them for two small airport runs last spring and they were great. That's why I trusted them with this. And I could forgive one late bus, because things happen. What I can't forgive is half the fleet not showing, no backup plan, and not one phone call while 220 people stood in a hotel driveway.

A driver finding out about a confirmed job at 5pm tells me something is broken in their dispatch. Until they fix it, I wouldn't put them on anything large or time-sensitive. If you already have them booked for January, I'd reconfirm in writing, get a direct cell number for someone other than the office line, and have a backup lined up.

I'll update this thread if they respond or make it right. Happy to share the confirmations and receipts with anyone who wants to see them.
